findings.text: the node own paragraph still states the acceptance as the regression test passing against the containing-cell read (that is the declared negative control, recorded with its log) and the lane as the eighteen-file topology CPU lane, but the delivered head makes the containing-cell read the retained failing negative finding (its receipt passes false at 46 of 444 differing wall nodes) and the accepted control the nearest-centre mutation, and runs the nineteen-file lane with its own new module; the appended decision and landing paragraphs supersede the clause in substance while the clause itself is unreconciled, so a reader of the node text alone would test the wrong acceptance and count the wrong lane.

this test asserts label-owned private wall flags (owner_label == PlasmaDomain.PRIVATE_FLUX) but passes at the delivered head (measured: 1 passed in 113.86s) because both fixtures happen to agree under the retired label rule and the new node-flux rule, so it is a green oracle for a retired rule, and it sits outside every lane, so nothing will fail when the two rules diverge elsewhere; the manifest reports it as a follow-on and the migration is owner-assigned, but until then its docstring claim that nearest-cell private labels own the mask is false of the code it tests.

the receipt declares nearest_in_material_retention as a diagnostic third column for one release, but no work item owns its retirement: the node follow-ons name the superseded telemetry test migration and integration verification only, so the release boundary that drops the nearest-in-material flags and the raster_bilinear_node_flux field would arrive with no scheduled removal and no lane to notice it.

justifications.durability: the rule is test-pinned by seven cases including a receipt-refusal gate that requires wall-node parity and a nonuniform-interpolation case, the negative control is a committed script that asserts its own exit status and mismatch string so a green run cannot pass as a control, and the negative finding is preserved as committed byte-identical objects with its digest recorded; the deductions are the unreconciled plan clause, the nearest-in-material retention declared for one release with no owning retirement (benchmarks/topology_parity_harness.py:731), and the superseded telemetry oracle, which still passes (measured at the reviewed head: 1 passed in 113.86s) because its two fixtures agree under both rules, so a green lane reads as confirmation of a retired rule.
justifications.evidence: every load-bearing claim was reproduced from the artefacts rather than read: sacct shows both jobs COMPLETED 0:0 with start times after the fix commit; the receipt totals (12 rows, 0 of 13068 cells, 0 of 444 nodes, 163 private, 48 nearest-in-material diagnostic differences) recompute from the stored JSON; the preserved negative receipt SHA256 equals the digest recorded in the anchor; the control log first line repeats the declared mutation verbatim with the failure exactly the two cross-leg nodes; reproduction.log shows the same oracle failing the contained-wall-node cases before the change (mismatches of 4 of 6 and 6 of 6); and the operand-independence paragraph is true as measured. The deduction is the base-revision chain: the zero-added-failure claim compares against the containing-cell lane (whose own base run recorded one environmental failure in an archive tree without .git, disclosed in the anchor) rather than a fresh lane at the true base, so the delta rests on a verified byte-identity plus that lane.
justifications.fit: mechanism-named symbols throughout (x_point_height_limits, private_wall_node_read, bilinear_node_flux) with no plan, sprint or version label in any path, symbol or comment; the limit helper is factored once and shared by the boundary path and the private-shadow read; the figures go through the nova.media painters with the wall drawn and the null vocabulary committed, and the marker vocabulary is conditional so a zero-difference row draws none; the receipt beside the figure and the one-job-per-measurement lanes follow the repository idioms.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the delivered rule is the accepted one and is met exactly: the flag is the node own flux against the admitted saddle by polarity, the height band is the shared limit the boundary path also uses, and no cell label participates; the deduction is that the plan own node paragraph still states the acceptance as passing against the containing-cell read, so the delivered control is not reproducible from the plan text alone even though the appended decision paragraph defines the node-flux rule as the goal.
justifications.scope_discipline: the fence held exactly: twelve changed paths all inside the eight declared write paths, the anchor record a new node-authored file whose later edits are the node own commits, no peer path, no other plan and no sprint state touched, only reports-directory artefacts outside the repository, and a clean worktree at the reviewed head; the superseded telemetry test is reported rather than edited.
